usage: graft [-h]
             {run,generate,druglike,ligprep,glide,amber-gbsa,prime_gbsa,md-gbsa,synthetic-feasibility,fep,status,report,combichem-3d} ...

Iterative molecular lead-optimization pipeline

positional arguments:
  {run,generate,druglike,ligprep,glide,amber-gbsa,prime_gbsa,md-gbsa,synthetic-feasibility,fep,status,report,combichem-3d}
    run                 Run one iteration with sequential stage workers
    generate            Run generate stage
    druglike            Run druglike stage
    ligprep             Run ligprep stage
    glide               Run glide stage
    amber-gbsa          Run amber-gbsa stage
    prime_gbsa          Run prime_gbsa stage
    md-gbsa             Run md-gbsa stage
    synthetic-feasibility
                        Evaluate generated compounds with AiZynthFinder
    fep                 Export FEP candidates or import FEP scores
    status              Show project DB status
    report              Write chemical-space, substituent and distribution
                        report from existing DB
    combichem-3d        Grow 3D frames using fragments or CReM, with
                        constrained search and clash filtering

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

A TOML path alone runs the supervisor: graft input/egfr.toml

usage: python -m graft.driver [-h] [--iteration ITERATION]
                              [--elite-mcs ELITE_MCS]
                              [--poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL] [--once]
                              project_toml

Single-thread supervisor for one iteration of sequential stage workers

positional arguments:
  project_toml

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --iteration ITERATION
                        Iteration to run; default: oldest unfinished, or next
                        new iteration
  --elite-mcs ELITE_MCS
                        Generation SMARTS override (takes precedence over
                        TOML)
  --poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL
                        Seconds before restarting an idle/exited worker
                        (default: 30)
  --once                Attempt each stage once in order; stop at the first
                        unfinished stage
